info.title: Dispatch alpha-worker and beta-worker subagents in parallel

messages.text: "Dispatch exactly two background subagents in one step: alpha-worker to append the line ALPHA to alpha.txt, and beta-worker to append the line BETA to beta.txt. Set background:true on both calls, then do not end your turn until both have finished. Do not edit the files yourself. Finally list the two child session IDs and the content of both files."

content.text: I'll dispatch both workers in one step with background mode.

Do not modify beta.txt or any other file. Report the final content of alpha.txt when done.
